summary: Exactly three applied 90-credit degrees were approved in November 2025 and are active Fall 2026: UMA Public Administration, UMFK Business Management and UMPI Psychology. At least 30 credits must be through the conferring campus;60/90 outside capacity is arithmetic, not a promise of 60 ACE credits. Adult-completer and two-year-gap conditions vary by program; UMA has distinct alternatives. Some employers/graduate programs may reject fewer than 120 credits; licensure and graduate admission are not guaranteed. UMA continuation is 121 credits. The article is ready for review; no executable course map or newly eligible degree recommendation is published. Product/editorial publication observed through the approved production run; exact URLs and bytes are retained. Existing unresolved degree mapping or current-policy research is not closed by this release.
